title: A novel monotonous finite volume element scheme for convection dominant diffusion problem
summary: One novel monotonous finite volume element (MFVE) scheme is put forward for convection dominant diffusion problem. The main contributions of this paper include four aspects. Firstly, one upwind sub-control volume, called upwind volume, is introduced for the discretization of the convection term similar to the upwind element, which leads to the upwind property.
